serviceKey.description: A CRM service credential `<id>.<secret>`, issued per enterprise workspace by `cli credential issue` (the secret is shown once, only its sha256 is stored). The credential's workspace scopes every call; no header names a workspace. A revoked credential is refused.

get.summary: List the workspace's contracts by number, optionally of one kind or one customer code.
Find customers by code, name, tax id, phone, e-mail or website domain.

post.summary: Open a customer of the books for a purchase; a customer with the same tax id, phone or mail is refused with its code.

get.summary: Get one customer with its website domains and linked contacts.
Get a customer's TK131 balance and open project receivables, side by side (a TK131 balance is not a debt).

post.summary: Link a Zalo id, e-mail or phone to a customer (writes crm_contacts; free; idempotent by address).

get.summary: List a customer's contracts from the contract register.
List a customer's document references (paths, never content).
Get a short-lived download link of the stored original of one of the customer's documents.
List the VAT invoices issued to a customer.
List a customer's recurring services (hosting, domain, SSL).

post.summary: Draft the VAT invoice of a paid renewal or a paid purchase; amounts computed by the CRM (issues nothing; one draft each).

get.summary: Get one invoice draft.
List the workspace's VAT invoices by number, optionally of one customer code and an issue period.
List the TK331 parties (suppliers) with their balance and supplier invoice notes.

post.summary: Note a supplier invoice against a TK331 party (writes crm_payable_notes; the amount stays in the e-invoice).

get.summary: List the price table by price code: NEW-sale and renewal rows (PLACEHOLDER until the owner's price sheet is loaded).

post.summary: Open a purchase for a new enquiry (state enquiry); the open purchase of the same channel and source is answered.

get.summary: List the open purchases with their quote and follow-up facts, optionally of one state or one source.
Get one purchase with its quote, state, payment code and reference, follow-ups and opened records.

patch.summary: Change the need or the contact as said, or mark the purchase lost with a note; no other state move.

post.summary: Record the acceptance of the quote: open the project, services, contract record, receivable and payment code (dry by default).
Record today's follow-up of an open purchase (one a day; a second one the same day replaces it).
Record a person's outcome: delivered once paid, or cancelled while open.
Mark an accepted purchase paid by the bank row that proves it (no amount); a row used by another request is refused.
Quote a purchase from the price table (the CRM computes every amount); the purchase moves to quoted.

get.summary: List the receivables with an amount remaining past due (or undated), with notice facts.

post.summary: Record a payment notice sent about a receivable (writes crm_receivable_notices; sends nothing).
Record that a bank transaction paid a receivable, by the bank row's id, never an amount (idempotent by transaction).
Open a renewal request awaiting payment on the customer's yes; the CRM computes total and transfer code (charges nothing).

get.summary: List the open renewal requests (awaiting payment, paid, waiting for a person).
Get one renewal request with its state, total, payment code and payment reference.

post.summary: A person confirms the provider outcome: renewed (moves the service's end date) or failed.
Mark a renewal request paid by the bank transaction that proves it, never an amount (moves no money).

get.summary: List services ending within a window with reachability and reminder facts (no verdict).

post.summary: Record a renewal reminder sent about a service, or the customer's answer (writes crm_service_reminders; sends nothing).
Renew a service at its provider for a PAID request (COSTS MONEY once a live plugin exists; dryRun defaults to true).

get.summary: Get a service's state from its provider plugin (manual: a person checks; fixture: the CRM's own row, nothing called).
Count the workspace's services, renewals and tickets per state, and its VAT invoices.
List tickets newest first, optionally of one customer or one status.

post.summary: Open a support ticket from a conversation or a mail (writes crm_tickets; sends nothing).

get.summary: Get one ticket with its summary and notes.

patch.summary: Add a note to a ticket and/or move its status (a closed ticket only reopens).
